answer: Bind each agent to a photo it submits at registration: every camera sensor stamps an invisible plume of fixed-pattern noise (PRNU) unique to that one piece of silicon. The ledger extracts and dedups this fingerprint, so a swarm of clones shot on a single camera all carry the same plume and collapse to one identity. The old fable that digital copies are free dies here, since each extra voice needs its own real sensor. Honest agents tend a garden of genuinely distinct devices; a fake fleet cannot conjure N cameras.
